A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FloorplanQA and provide readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and complete appendices. Corresponding material can be matched despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v2 reports original evaluations of 15 LLMs on 16,000 layout-question pairs, including ablations, detailed accuracy tables, and failure analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark evaluations and adds original tool-assisted, multimodal, parsing, and scoring-sensitivity results.

M1.justification: The reported HSSD construction pipeline replaces alpha-shape/hull cleanup with Douglas-Peucker simplification at 0.01 m (Section 3 and Appendix C). Synthetic generation and core task procedures remain. The PDFs do not establish whether existing layouts and reference answers were regenerated.

E1.justification: The 2,000 layouts and eight tasks retain the same room and domain coverage. Appendix F adds visual-input scenarios: contour renderings alongside JSON for HSSD and synthetic layouts, plus icon renderings for synthetic layouts.

E2.justification: The original 15-model roster remains. v3 Tables 2 and 8 add comparisons against Python-assisted and image-plus-JSON variants of GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1-mini, extending the comparison methods for two retained backbones.

E3.justification: New tool/image evaluations use 200 HSSD and 200 synthetic scenes, the latter comprising 50 kitchens, 75 living rooms, and 75 bedrooms. v3 also adds alternative answer extraction and numeric/Fréchet threshold sweeps. Reported HSSD preprocessing changes, and the temperature-1 exception expands from GPT-5 to the GPT-5 family; these statements do not establish reruns.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained format, object-reference, and semantic ablations, v3 adds tool/visual controls, two tool-code failure cases (Figure 8), error distributions and threshold sweeps (Figures 9–12), and parsing robustness checks (Table 7). These investigate arithmetic assistance, scoring-threshold dependence, and extraction confounds.

E5.justification: Generation-seed disclosure and descriptive mean/standard-deviation reporting remain. No repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or new uncertainty-estimation procedures are introduced. The added error-distribution plots analyze prediction errors.

E6.justification: Tables 2 and 8 add tool/image results, including GPT-4.1 HSSD distance accuracy of 56.0% raw versus 99.0% with tools. Retained reports also change: Claude/GPT-4.1 visibility columns are exchanged in the full-data table, and reasoning accuracy on completed answers is extensively revised—for example, DeepSeek HSSD distance changes from 25.5% in v2 Table 13 to 85.0% in v3 Table 15. These are additional conditions and reporting revisions.

T1.justification: The geometric constraints and ground-truth computations in the generation and case-study appendices remain substantively unchanged. Angle and maximization notation edits are equivalent; no new theorem, proof, or substantive derivation appears.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal benchmark contributions remain essentially unchanged. The conclusion adds claims about strong tool benefits on arithmetic-heavy tasks, limited planning benefits, and inconsistent advantages from visual input.

C2.justification: v3 extends the existing geometric-reasoning interpretation with incorrect tool-generated algorithms and boundary-contact failures, and interprets selective visual-input benefits. Section 3.4 newly qualifies accuracy on non-truncated answers as potentially inflated because difficult questions are preferentially truncated.

D1.justification: v3 discloses coordinate-frame conversion, the 0.01 m simplification tolerance, 720×720 rendering specifications, and dated GPT-4.1 model identifiers. It newly describes the dataset as publicly available, without supplying a new access link; both versions refer to supplementary code and prompts.

R1.justification: v3 adds Douglas and Peucker (1973) and removes the two alpha-shape references. Related work more precisely distinguishes Yamada et al.'s qualitative spatial relations and BALROG's implicit navigation from explicit coordinate-based geometry. Most other citation changes are bibliographic updates.

P1.justification: The method section merges and reorders the layout-source discussion and moves the representation description into the unified-dataset section. Results and conclusion are extensively rewritten. The appendices gain a roadmap and substantial reorganization of existing analyses, beyond merely inserting new experiments.

P2.justification: v3 adopts a two-column main layout, resizes and rearranges figures/tables, incorporates the old layout-distribution display into Figure 1, and adds diagnostic displays. Figure 6 also incorrectly replaces the earlier general-model question radar panels with duplicated reasoning-model panels.

improvement.justification: v3 strengthens validation through controlled tool/image comparisons and tolerance/parser checks, and largely repairs v2's reasoning table that repeated raw accuracies under a completed-answers caption. These gains improve interpretation, but new reporting defects limit the net improvement: Figure 6 duplicates reasoning panels, and Figure 11 claims unchanged rankings despite crossings in the free-space curves.
